scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hiveflow/shared && concurrently --kill-others -n shared,api,web "npm run dev -w @hiveflow/shared" "npm run dev -w @hiveflow/api" "npm run dev -w @hiveflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hiveflow/shared && npm run build -w @hiveflow/api && npm run build -w @hiveflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hiveflow/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
